d: Russian President Vladimir Putin is making a fresh push for influence in Africa. Addressing leaders from across the continent, Putin attacked what he called the “colonial West” and accused Western countries of exploiting Africa and leaving it burdened with debt. Moscow is offering three things: technology, more food and fertiliser supplies, and support for greater African influence in institutions such as the IMF and World Bank.
